newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks open lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks open lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened lower Wednesday, with the Dow industrials down 46 points to 7715 in early trading.
The Nasdaq composite was off 11 points to 1433.
Analysts said the market was weighed down by earnings warnings from several high-profile computer companies.
Gateway 2000 Inc and Seagate Technology Inc warned of lower-than-expected results after the bell Tuesday. The stocks were indicated to open sharply lower.
The 30-year bond was off 6/32 to yield 6.74 percent. The S&P index futures were off 2.65 at 900.15.
